acceptanceCriteria: The compiled server stops its managed page after terminal collection/cancellation, preserves CAPTCHA pages, and serializes cleanup with safe reuse.
goal:
Fix browser/control-server.ts retaining active Chromium documents after collection ends. Production browser kept consuming one CPU and 1.5GiB hours after completion/cancellation. Keep strict TypeScript, preserve data/history/cookies/profile and unrelated tabs/external browser, keep hosted application stopped, no live xe.gr or personal profiles. This is one lifecycle defect; do not change parsers or build layout.

Independent review of the previous cancelled attempt found concrete failures you must avoid:
- Detail CAPTCHA calls store.savePause with pauseType captcha and writes a paused checkpoint, then collector THROWS. Server catch sets status error. Checking only the returned result.status === paused wrongly blanks that human verification page. Preserve actual pending CAPTCHA using durable/session evidence even through catch, until explicit verification/resume or cancellation. Explicit cancellation takes precedence.
- Idle POST /api/cancel awaited about:blank BEFORE persisting cancellation or taking admission. Holding page.goto(about:blank) pending then POST /api/start returned202 and traversed. Reserve admission/persist cancellation before the first await; hold admission through bounded cleanup including cancel-lift/start/scheduled races; release even on failure.
- Promise.race timeout does not cancel goto. A late cleanup navigation on a reused page can erase the next run; reject/hang handling must retire that managed page safely and return a usable replacement in the SAME context, without closing external browser or unrelated tabs. A closed page must not remain cached. Native operation timeout plus safe fallback/retirement should be considered; do not silently reuse a potentially still-navigating page. Cleanup must not mask primary failure or leak unhandled rejections.
- Do not skip cleanup for injected test sessions merely because owned is undefined to make existing tests pass. Old tests assert exact network navigations; update those expectations narrowly for deliberate about:blank cleanup while preserving their real admission/data/error assertions.

Add focused deterministic tests driving REAL compiled createServer + real collector/store with controllable session pages: completed/error cleanup; real detail-CAPTCHA throw preserves page then explicit cancel stops it; idle cancel with held cleanup refuses competing start; cleanup reject/timeout safely allows later work without old page navigation affecting it. Use barriers/poll progress.active rather than short sleeps; do not weaken historical regressions. Demonstrate baseline failure then final pass.

Offline real Chromium proof using a fresh temporary profile and loopback fixtures must put an activity heartbeat on BOTH search AND detail pages, establish activity before termination and zero increase afterward, preserve pending detail challenge, cookies/context/unrelated tab, and allow a subsequent collection. Record actual source assertions and command results. Existing browser-local Playwright install may be used separately. Root tests must not need browser dependencies.

Final verification: create one fresh external source copy with recursive exclusion of node_modules, dist, .git and ALL .atoma-prefixed entries BEFORE copying (preserve file modes). Run root npm ci then npm run check in that SAME copy, separate recorded commands. Keep all historical data/test files and Vite output layout. No deployment, restart, live collection or broad refactoring. Deliver only this correction and its focused proofs.
